blocks.text: The woes of the “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0” are far from over as the officials of the Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) and the National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) are set to meet to discuss concerns about disability sensitivity hounding the show. The meeting was prompted by a complaint letter submitted by the NCDA alleging violations on the part of some PBB housemates who were called out by viewers and netizens for allegedly imitating speech characteristics associated with persons with disabilities (PWD).
